entries.annotation: re-review of the key the 2026-08-15 verdict produced, not of the product it judged
entries.reason: 'Garlic' (Aldi, $0.5633/lb, whole garlic; peer cells Kroger Whole Garlic Bulbs $0.498/lb and Walmart Fresh Garlic Sleeve $0.58/lb) is correctly matched to the garlic commodity and is KEPT. This entry is needed because audit-match-soundness's verdict gate recovers the judged item from the first quoted string in a verdict's reason text instead of from the entry's own 'item' field. The 2026-08-15 verdict judged 'Marketside Tandoori Style Garlic Naan Bites, 7.05 oz, 15 Count' and its reason quotes the bare word 'Garlic' as a flavour descriptor, so the gate built key garlic|garlic and refused -Accept by naming this real product. The actually-judged naan bites remain DROPPED: they are suppressed by GLOBAL_EXCLUDE 'naan', carry a known-wrong entry, and hold no cell on the 2026-08-16 board. Nothing about that ruling is reversed here.
